[/b][b]Stardew Valley ATM Mod:[/b]
Current Gameplay Overview:[list=1]
[*][b]ATM Machine[/b]:
Located next to the town clinic, you can use it to deposit, withdraw, take out loans, and repay loans.

[*][b]Deposits[/b]:
(1) You can choose between demand deposits and fixed deposits, each with different interest rates. The longer the term, the higher the interest.
(2) To avoid certain issues, you can make up to 5 fixed deposits.
(3) At the end of each day, interest will be automatically calculated on all deposits over 2,000 gold. Fixed deposit interest is calculated per transaction, and fractional interest will be rounded up automatically.
(4) Upon maturity, each fixed deposit will be automatically transferred into your demand account.
(5) You can only withdraw from your demand account balance.
(6) The interest rate of your demand account is not fixed; it fluctuates randomly each day and is not displayed.

[*][b]Loans[/b]:
(1) The maximum loan amount is calculated based on your in-game time, with a cap of 500,000 gold.
(2) To avoid fractional issues, you can only take out loans in multiples of 1,000 gold, with a minimum loan of 1,000 gold.
(3) After taking out a loan, a start date for repayment will be set. You must make daily repayments from the start of the repayment period until the end. Repayment is not required before the start date, allowing you a few days to earn money.
(4) Interest rates vary based on the loan term, resulting in different daily interest amounts.
(5) You can manually repay the daily amount or choose to repay the entire loan early. Repayments will first deduct from your demand account balance; if that is insufficient, it will deduct from your personal funds.
(6) If you do not repay on a given day, the system will automatically deduct from your balance the next day. This process does not incur penalties and is considered an automatic repayment.
(7) If your balance is insufficient for automatic repayment, a late penalty will be applied.
Example: If you owe 110 gold but only have 100 gold in your balance, the system will deduct 100 gold. The remaining 10 gold will incur a penalty of 10 * 0.1 = 1 gold. The next day, you will need to repay the following amount: today's debt + yesterday's debt + the penalty.

[/list][list=1]

[/list]星露谷物语ATM模组：
现有玩法介绍：
1、在小镇医院旁边有一个ATM机，您可以在此进行存款、取款、贷款、还款
2、存款：
(1)、您可以选择活期存款和定期存款，它们的利率各不相同，时间越久，利息越高。
(2)、为了规避一些问题，您最多只能进行5次定期存款。
(3)、在每日结束前，所有大于2000元的存款会自动计算利息，定期根据每单笔存款进行计算，利息产生的小数金额会自动取整。
(4)、每笔定期存款到期后，会自动存入活期账户。
(5)、您只能取出活期账户里的余额。
(6)、您的活期账户利率不会是固定的，每日都会随机起伏，不会给予显示。
3、贷款：
(1)、最高贷款额度会根据您的游戏时长进行计算，上限为50万。
(2)、为了规避小数问题，您只能贷款1000的整数倍金额，并且最少贷款1000元。
(3)、在您贷款后，会计算一个开始还款时间，您需要在开始还款时间到结束还款时间内的每一天进行还款。在开始还款时间之前不会让您还款，让您有几天的挣钱时间。
(4)、根据您的贷款时长不同，利率也会不同，所产生的每日利息也不同。
(5)、您可以手动进行当日还款，也可以选择提前偿还所有贷款，还款会优先扣掉您银行活期余额，若您银行余额不足，会选择扣除您自身的钱。
(6)、若您在当日未进行还款，在第二天开始时系统会自动扣掉您的余额进行还款，此过程不会产生违约金，也算是一种自动还款的方式。
(7)、若当自动还款时，您的余额不足，会产生逾期违约金。
例如：您欠款110元，但您的余额只有100元，系统会扣掉100元，遗留下来的10元会计算10*0.1=1的违约金，在第二天您需要还款的金额为： 当天欠款+昨日欠款+违约金
兼容：
此模组兼容SVE，里奇塞德村等大型模组，一般不会对您现有模组产生冲突。
此模组兼容多人联机，每人存款、贷款都以自身为准，存款和贷款数据不会共享。
由于本人测试条件有限，无法兼顾各种各样复杂环境，若您遇到问题，请及时与我联系!
